column4: M3BlockCache is the viewport row-block table (parent/block int lanes, UI-thread owner, linear slot scan); M3SetAssociativeCache and M3ConcurrentLruCache are scaffolds that throw M3NotYetReceived (Agrona Int2ObjectCache int keys; object LRU); M3LFUCache is a small LFU object cache and M3LongLfuCache a primitive long-to-long LFU; M3PreparationCache (package-private to jdk.m3.search) is an entry-count and key-length bounded LRU of compiled preparations keyed by String, compiling outside the monitor like this cache but with no byte budget, no content identity and no trim generation; M3PrecomputeCache maps precompute bundles by content id; M3ChunkSha computes chunk digests but caches nothing. None keys on SHA-256 + exact raw bytes + wire profile, budgets raw + encoded bytes, refuses mutating encoders or revokes in-flight fills on trim
